title: Firearm Volume 1 #1 September 1993 Malibu Comics Ultraverse - James Robinson
descriptionText: The product is a comic book titled Firearm Volume 1 #1 from September 1993 by Malibu Comics as part of the Ultraverse series. Written by James Robinson, the comic falls under the genres of superheroes, action, and adventure. The main character of the series is Firearm, making it a collectible item for fans of comic books and graphic novels. This issue offers readers a glimpse into the world of superheroics and intense action within the Ultraverse universe created by James Robinson.
